hooks: Guide first posted Nov 2017 and updated Oct 12, 2026, with a full Korean beauty section (source article)
Says Olive Young N Seongsu is the largest Olive Young in Korea, with a K-pop zone (source article)
Lists the 15 Pow!Wow! Korea street-art murals from 2019 by artist name (source article)

list.title: Seongsu-dong cafes, K-beauty & shops, from The Soul of Seoul's guide
list.desc: Places from The Soul of Seoul's 'Seongsu-dong: Things To Do, Best Cafes, & Shopping in the Brooklyn of Seoul' (https://thesoulofseoul.net/seongsudong-seoul-korea/). Collected by PinWith, not made by The Soul of Seoul.

items.title: Common Ground (커먼그라운드)
items.memo: Shipping-container mall with pop-ups, shows and exhibitions.

items.title: Monami Store Seongsu (모나미스토어 성수점)
items.memo: Stationery concept store: mix your own ink, build and engrave a pen.

items.title: Dior Seongsu (디올 성수)
items.memo: Concept space modeled on 30 Montaigne; many just photograph outside.

items.title: Daelim Changgo (대림창고)
items.memo: Converted warehouses with cafes, restaurants and art.

items.title: Han Jung Sun (한정선)
items.memo: Fruit-filled chapssaltteok rice cakes; takeaway only.

items.title: Seongsu Yeonbang (성수연방)
items.memo: Three-floor complex with cafes, restaurants, a bookstore and shop.

items.title: Olive Young N Seongsu (올리브영N 성수)
items.memo: Called Korea's largest Olive Young, with a K-pop zone and photo zones.

items.title: Amore Seongsu (아모레 성수)
items.memo: Free product testing, OSulloc cafe upstairs and a rooftop. Closed Mon.

items.title: Amuse Seongsu (어뮤즈 성수)
items.memo: Pink two-floor flagship; fill your own Mini Tint lid.

items.title: Tamburins Seongsu (탬버린즈 성수)
items.memo: Fragrance brand from Gentle Monster's makers, known for exhibitions.

items.title: TIRTIR Seongsu (티르티르 성수)
items.memo: Mask Fit Red Cushion brand; AI skin analysis and custom lip station.

items.title: Innisfree The Isle (이니스프리 디아일)
items.memo: Flagship with a calm in-store cafe for drinks and desserts.

items.title: Seoul Forest (서울숲)
items.memo: Former royal hunting grounds; blossoms, skate park, deer in Eco Forest.
